We have search results list of templates. Need to return mapped_rxn and template_id (the one used to search the database not the hash). The template_id likely is reaction_id? The prompt says "template_id (the one used to search the database not the hash) as an integer". In search results each entry has 'reaction_id' and 'template_hash'. So template_id is reaction_id. We need the template that reproduces the reaction described: aromatic amine attacks electrophilic sulfur of phenylsulfonyl chloride, then collapse, etc. The target molecule is given: O=S(NC1=...)(C5=...)=O. That's a sulfonamide with phenylsulfonyl group attached to aromatic amine. The forward reaction: phenylsulfonyl chloride + aromatic amine -> sulfonamide + HCl. So retrosynthetic step: break N-S bond and form S-Cl bond? Actually retrosynthesis: disconnect N-S to give sulfonyl chloride and amine. So template should have bonds broken: N-S, formed: S-Cl? Wait forward: S-Cl broken, N-S formed. In retrosynthesis, we break N-S and form S-Cl. So we need template that when applied to product (sulfonamide) gives sulfonyl chloride + amine. The search results include several templates. The first entry reaction_id 20810 has retro_smarts_template: [C:5]-[#8:6]-[c:7]1...>>Cl-[S...]-[c:4].[C:5]-[#8:6]-[c:7]1... This seems to break N-S? Let's examine: retro_smarts_template shows product side (left) is [C:5]-[#8:6]-[c:7]1... which is an aryl ether? Actually it's a phenoxy? Hard to parse. But the mapped_rxn shows a reaction where Cl-[S...]... and a phenoxy aryl? The product side is the sulfonamide? The mapped_rxn shows product: ...[NH:15][S:16](=[O:17])(=[O:18])[c:19]... So product contains N-S bond. Reactants: Cl[S:16]... and [C:5]-[#8:6]-[c:7]... which is an aryl ether? Actually it's a phenoxy group attached to something else. Not our amine. Our amine is aromatic amine attached to sulfonyl. The amine is part of a heterocycle? The target molecule includes an aniline attached to sulfonyl, plus a complex bicyclic moiety attached to the nitrogen? Wait structure: O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O. So sulfonamide nitrogen attached to aromatic ring (C1...). That aromatic ring also has a substituent N2CCN(...). So the amine is an aniline (aryl amine). So template should involve aromatic amine (primary) reacting with sulfonyl chloride. The search result entry 20810 seems to involve aromatic amine? It has [NH;D2;+0:11] attached to S. That matches sulfonamide. The other reactant is Cl-[S...]... and a phenoxy? Actually the other reactant is [C:5]-[#8:6]-[c:7]1... which is maybe an aryl ether (phenoxy). Not our amine. So not correct.

Look at other entries: reaction_id 1087545 has retro_smarts_template: [O;D1;H0:4]=[S;H0;D4;+0:3](=[O;D1;H0:5])(-[c:6])-[NH;D2;+0:1]-[c:2]>>Cl-C-c1:c:c:c(-S(=O)(=O)-[NH;D2;+0:1]-[c:2]):c:c:1.Cl-[S;H0;D4;+0:3]... This seems to have product side (left) as sulfonamide with aromatic amine attached to sulfonyl attached to aromatic ring (c:6). Reactants: Cl-C-c1... (aryl chloride?) and Cl-[S...]... So one reactant is aryl chloride (maybe phenylsulfonyl chloride) and the other is aryl chloride? Actually Cl-C-c1... is a chlorobenzene? That seems not amine. So not.

Reaction_id 1755033: similar with F substituents.

We need template where reactants are aromatic amine and sulfonyl chloride. Look through entries: maybe entry 1087547? It has retro_smarts_template: [O;D1;H0:6]=[S;H0;D4;+0:5](=[O;D1;H0:7])(-[c:8])-[NH;D2;+0:4]-[c:3]:[cH;D2;+0:1]:[c:2]>>C-O-[c;H0;D3;+0:1](:[c:2]):[c:3]-[NH2;D1;+0:4].Cl-[S;H0;D4;+0:5]... This seems to involve phenoxy? Not.

Maybe there is a template not in list because we limited to 10. Could search again with functional groups broken/formed. Use functional_groups_formed: 'sulfonamides' maybe. Let's search with functional_groups_formed 'sulfonamides' and broken 'sulfonyl chloride'? Actually functional groups broken: 'acyl chloride' maybe? The sulfonyl chloride is a sulfonyl chloride functional group. The functional group list includes 'acyl chloride' but not sulfonyl chloride. Might not.

We can search for templates where product contains sulfonamide and reactants include aryl amine and sulfonyl chloride. Could search by functional_groups_formed 'sulfonamides' and functional_groups_broken 'acyl chloride'? Let's try.
